new: Studio: trigger cubes can switch other trigger cubes off and on. On a cube's card, Pick what it hides (switches off) or Pick what it shows (switches on), then press the other cube, or a group's member to take all of the group's cubes. A cube some cube switches on waits switched off until then.

A cube switched off while you stand in it acts as if you walked out: what it showed hides again, its loops stop, its 'as you leave' reactions run; what a stay cube made stays. Switched on while you stand in it, it acts as if you walked in.
Sequences and press reactions can switch cubes on and off too (Switch it on / Switch it off). While editing, a switched-off cube is drawn darker and its card says what switched it off.
Rooms are now format 49: every device needs this release to join the same room.
test: In the headset: two cubes that switch each other off (a pair of radio buttons): walk into one, then the other; the first one should keep the second off.
A door: a cube in front of a room switches on a cube inside it; walking in should start what the inside cube does only after you passed the first.
Switch a cube off from a press on an object, and from a sequence; walk into it and check nothing happens until it is switched on again.
untested: Everything with a real head and real controllers: walking into switching cubes, picking cubes with the trigger, how the darker cube and its tag read in the headset.
Cubes for everyone switching each other across several real headsets; a late joiner to a pair of such cubes may settle the other way.
